recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless a work group separately decides to reintroduce an OID extension, which would be new work rather than completion of FHIR-5568.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 correction asking to change the URI link and description for the ValueSet OID extension because the old valueset-oid URL was being used for code system OIDs and implied value-set-only semantics.
initial_application: Commit 089bbf555b41fedf41b9e30b499689ee62d390c4 (#5568) updated source/valueset/valueset-extensions-spreadsheet.xml so the OID extension description referred to the object identified by the URI and included code system, value set, and identifier-system examples. It did not rename the URL in that commit, but the affected source file is no longer present in the current build.
additional_context: Commit 127b78439c60e54c876f20860ee41f26d8b3450c later removed the OID extension from ValueSet and CodeSystem extension spreadsheets with the rationale to use identifier. Current source/fhir.ini actively includes ValueSet and CodeSystem, and their StructureDefinition sources define url elements that can be urn:oid plus repeatable identifier elements for formal/business identifiers. Current core and the FHIR Extension Pack contain no remaining valueset-oid or generic oid extension definition.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current specification no longer contains the misleading extension FHIR-5568 targeted, so there is no in-scope source edit to make.

related_jiras.note: Later Identifier.system clarification arose from ValueSet.identifier confusion after the OID extension era; it concerns the Identifier datatype and was not decided here.
